hello.speaker: bram
hello.text: Welcome to the Gilded Heron! Warm stew, dry beds and, saints forgive me, rats the size of hounds in my cellar.

rats.speaker: bram
rats.text: Came up through the old drain, I reckon. One of them bit my pot-boy. I locked the cellar and I have not slept since. Clear them out and there is coin in it for you.

choices.text: Coin, and a potion from under your counter.

accept.speaker: bram
accept.text: Bless you. Here is the key. The cellar door is just there, in the far wall.

accept_bonus.speaker: bram
accept_bonus.text: You drive a hard bargain for someone who has not seen them yet. Done. Coin and a potion. Here is the key.

accept_plain.speaker: bram
accept_plain.text: Coin is what I have. Here is the key. The cellar door is in the far wall.

waiting.speaker: bram
waiting.text: Still scratching down there. The key is in your pack, and the door is in the far wall.

report.speaker: bram
report.text: Quiet! Blessed quiet. Here, you have earned every copper.

done.speaker: bram
done.text: Stew is on. Sit anywhere you like.

rumor.speaker: bram
rumor.text: Old Elsbeth's boy went up there on a dare and never came down. She waits in the square every evening, poor soul.
